title: --title
body:
FreeDOS VM boots successfully in QEMU with DESQview/X installed. Server.com runs under CWSDPMI but crashes with divide-by-zero errors due to CWSDPMI lacking full VCPI services. 

Achievements:
- FreeDOS boots successfully (FDCONFIG.SYS -> FDAUTO.BAT)
- DESQview/X installed from 9 floppy images
- Original SERVER.COM (256-byte stub) + SERVER.EXE (42KB PKLITE) intact
- SERVER.EXE decompressed to 67,572 bytes
- DESQCHK.COM TSR created - hooks INT 21h/2Bh, returns AL=0 (non-DESQview path)
- CWSDPMI.EXE loads as DPMI host (persistent mode -p -s-)

Key files:
- _WORK_/desqview-x/disk/freedos.qcow2 - base FreeDOS image
- /tmp/freedos_clean.qcow2 - working image with CWSDPMI -p -s-
- /tmp/DESQCHK.COM - TSR hook (INT 21h/2Bh)
- /tmp/SERVER_UNP.PATCHED.EXE - decompressed MZ EXE server

Blocker: CWSDPMI is a 32-bit only DPMI server, doesn't support 16-bit DPMI apps or provide full VCPI services needed by DESQview/X server. Server crashes with divide-by-zero at 10C4 and spurious interrupts.

Next steps (require infrastructure):
1. Install HDPMI32 from FreeDOS packages (via FDNPKG) - provides full DPMI/VCPI
2. Use DOSBox-X instead of QEMU - built-in DPMI/VCPI support works better than raw TCG
3. Try CWSDPMI -x flag to disable DPMI 1.0 extensions
4. Patch divide-by-zero at runtime address 10C4

Task infrastructure ready for continuation when HDPMI32 or DOSBox-X available.
